world_context.dialogue:
Huh?
Who… Who are you?
… … … … … … … …
… … … … … … … …
Oh, you're ASH.
So your move was today.
Um… I'm MAY.
Glad to meet you!
I…
I have this dream of becoming friends
with POKéMON all over the world.
I… I heard about you, ASH, from
my dad, PROF. BIRCH.
I was hoping that you would be nice,
ASH, and that we could be friends.
Oh, this is silly, isn't it?
I… I've just met you, ASH.
Eheheh…
Oh, no! I forgot!
I was supposed to go help Dad catch
some wild POKéMON!
ASH, I'll catch you later!
